_: How shorts look and which services make them. Prices are fal's, per second of video, as of Nov 2026: check fal.ai/models if they change.

scene._: Each episode's environment, painted from its script's scene: line (lib/scenes.mjs) and kept in shorts/backgrounds/.
scene.style: Photoreal 3D render of an empty set in a grotesque body-horror world where everything is made of skin, flesh, teeth, hair and goo: wet, glossy, organic surfaces, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, moody and a little dark, eye-level view. No people, no creatures, no faces, no text or lettering anywhere. Keep the middle of the picture fairly plain and uncluttered, where characters will be placed.

style: grotesque, wet, glossy 3D creature render; unhinged, psychotic, frenetic cartoon acting: manic twitching, sudden jerky head movements, eyes darting and bulging, huge rubbery expressions snapping between extremes.

pace._: The gap after each line, in seconds (lines ending in ... still linger, lines ending in — get none).

voice._: provider fal: voices designed from each character's brief (ElevenLabs v3 on fal, $0.10 per 1000 characters, commercial use included). provider elevenlabs: the stock voices named in cast.json, through your own ElevenLabs account.

chorus._: cast.json chorus: { voice } puts a chorus under a character's lines: the same take through the voice changer into that voice (so every word lands together), levelled to match the main voice, as copies pitched up by `pitches` (formants too, so they sound small), each `delays` ms late, at `volume` each (times the character's own `level`, if set). The first copy only a little higher, so the words stay clear; four at 0.32 come to about 5 dB under the main voice (voiced, so they still stand out against a whisper).

asmr._: ASMR, matched to the reference (an extreme close-up ASMR reel): dry, near the centre, squeezed tight (loudness range `range`), crisp on top, the environment low (`bedLoudness`). Every character has a second, soft-spoken voice designed from their brief plus `brief` (saved as <id>~asmr in voices.json; designed again if `brief` changes), so the mouth sounds come from the voice itself. Pitch effects are kept, the muffling ones aren't; then the close-mic treatment (chain). Yelled lines use their normal voice. A script's asmr: off turns it off.
asmr.brief: Speaking softly and slowly, right up against a very sensitive microphone, like a close-up ASMR video: quiet and intimate but clearly voiced, never whispering. Every word comes with crisp little clicks of the tongue, soft sticky mouth sounds and audible breaths. The same character and the same strangeness, just extremely close.

talking.noText: No text, captions, subtitles, letters or writing anywhere in the picture.

action.negative: blur, distortion, low quality, extra limbs, text, watermark, human hands

edit._: Draws characters turned left and right (lib/poses.mjs), on fal.

props._: Props (prop: in a script), drawn once each and kept in shorts/props/.
props.style: Photoreal 3D render, grotesque, wet and glossy, organic and crusty, cinematic lighting, like a gross stop-motion puppet prop.

mouth._: ASMR mouth close-ups: now and then, in a pause (after a silent beat or a line that trails off), the picture cuts to an extreme close-up of that character's mouth, the tongue moving, with the sound of it. Each character's is made once: a macro still drawn from their picture (model, $0.15) and clipSeconds of it moving with its own sound (video, about $0.63); each insert is a slice of it. `auto` per episode, `seconds` long ([shortest, longest]). A script's mouth: N or off changes how many; > NAME (1.5s, mouth) puts one in by hand.
mouth.still: Extreme macro close-up of this exact creature's mouth only, filling the whole picture from edge to edge: the same skin, teeth, colours and photoreal 3D render style, the mouth slightly open, the tip of the tongue just showing, glistening, soft dramatic light, no background visible.
mouth.clip: Extreme macro close-up of a grotesque creature's mouth filling the frame: the mouth opens slowly and the tongue moves around slowly inside it, glistening, with small sticky mouth and tongue sounds. The camera holds perfectly still. Grotesque, glossy 3D creature render. Quiet, very close-microphone mouth sounds only: no music, no voice, no words.

music._: Music under the title: it fades away as the first line is said (until: "first line"; anything else keeps it under the whole episode). Each track is the game's Suno music given a treatment once: the creepy ones are slowed, detuned, darkened and drowned in echo.

sounds._: A script's sounds: line is made into a looping environment once (ElevenLabs sound effects on fal, $0.002 a second), kept in shorts/sounds/, and played at `loudness` (LUFS; the voices are about -16).

ambience._: A bed of sound under everything, so silences aren't dead air (a script's ambience: picks another, or none).

hits._: Sound hits on the camera's punches, shakes and snaps to close-ups, made once each.

sounds.hit: a single short wet fleshy slap impact, cartoon, punchy
sounds.rattle: a short violent wet rattling shudder, like something fleshy being shaken hard, cartoon
sounds.whoosh: a very fast short cartoon whoosh, a quick swish of air

energy._: frantic: the camera trembles and snaps in at random (a script's energy: calm turns it off). jitter is pixels; jolts come every so many seconds and zoom in by so much.

vhs._: Bursts of VHS static (picture and sound), every few seconds and only between lines. A script's vhs: off turns them off.

film._: Films (shorts/film.mjs, shorts/films/): shots made elsewhere, cut with the kit's sound. `style` goes after every painted key frame's description (painted by scene.model, or edit.model when characters are in it, at scene.price); `drift` is how far a key frame pushes in while it stands in for a shot not filmed yet; `chat` is how `--chat` asks a Claude chat to film a shot on Higgsfield (a model its free trial's unlimited generations cover).
film.style: Photoreal cinematic film still of a grotesque, wet, glossy, organic world where the land itself is skin, flesh, hair and goo: macro nature photography, soft atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, moody natural light, muted fleshy colours, 35mm. No text, lettering, logos or borders anywhere.
